section.p: My name is Francisco but you can call me Fran! As a Software Engineer, I’ve been 'introducing' bugs since 2011!

After years across frontend and architecture, I’ve moved into applied AI, working hands-on with coding agents. I run a small parallel fleet of them with shared project memory and automated checks, and I’ve shipped a couple of self-initiated agentic proofs of concept at Santander.
When I’m not at the day job, I’m learning the AI-engineering basics — LLM APIs, RAG, evaluation, agentic workflows and MCP — and tinkering with open source side projects like broadmand and framer.
